item.title: Neural chip decodes interactions between brain regions
item.description:
📝 0 EPFL researchers have developed an implantable neural chip that tracks communication across brain regions, identifying cognitive and emotional states in real time. Dubbed LogSync, it records brain activity and extracts biomarkers that describe the strength of brain waves (oscillations) and synchrony between signals from different brain regions. More targeted stimulation at lower powerThe researchers evaluated LogSync using human brain recordings from previous psychiatric experiments.
🔗 Read more: https://actu.epfl.ch/news/neural-chip-decodes-interactions-between-brain-r-2/
